feature: Public landing addendum A4: tips on phones (design_handoff_the99_public_landing/addendum-phone-tips, boards A4 · Phone, A4 · Behaviour, A4 · Desktop). Below 768 an opened credit tip sits in the list's flow and pushes the rows under it down; 768 and up keep the floating tip as shipped.
note: Read-only, audit account on local-dev. The sheet always signs in, and `/` draws the landing only signed out with PUBLIC_LANDING_ENABLED on, so these rows use the admin-only /preview/landing (the same `landingTree`): serve the dev server with ADMIN_USER_IDS set to the audit account's Clerk id and ADMIN_ENV_LABEL=staging in the process environment (never in .env; the label only lets requireAdmin pass, so open no /admin page on that server). Signed in, the shell's phone tab bar sits over the foot of the viewport, which the public `/` does not draw; the into-view scroll is measured against the window, so the last-row cell shows the tip's foot just above the screen's foot, under the tab bar. Press elsewhere and Escape are held by credit-tips.test.tsx.
